name: @iflow-mcp/malaksedarous-context-optimizer-mcp-server

tools.name: askAboutFile
tools.description: Extract specific information from files without reading their entire contents into chat context. Works with text files, code files, images, PDFs, and more.

filePath.description: Full absolute path to the file to analyze (e.g., "C:/Users/username/project/src/file.ts", "/home/user/project/docs/README.md")

question.description: Specific question about the file content (e.g., "Does this file export a validateEmail function?", "What is the main purpose described in this spec?", "Extract all import statements")

tools.name: runAndExtract
tools.description: Execute terminal commands and intelligently extract specific information from their output. Supports cross-platform command execution with security controls.

terminalCommand.description: Shell command to execute. Must be non-interactive (no user input prompts). Navigation commands (cd, pushd, etc.) are not allowed - use workingDirectory instead.

extractionPrompt.description: Natural language description of what information to extract from the command output. Examples: "Show me the raw output", "Summarize the results", "Extract all error messages", "Find version numbers", "List all files", "Did the command succeed?", "Are there any warnings?"

workingDirectory.description: Full absolute path where command should be executed (e.g., "C:\Users\username\project", "/home/user/project"). Must be within configured security boundaries.

tools.name: askFollowUp
tools.description: Ask follow-up questions about the previous terminal command execution without re-running the command. Only available after using runAndExtract tool.

question.description: Follow-up question about the previous terminal command execution and its output

tools.name: researchTopic
tools.description: Conduct quick, focused web research on software development topics using Exa.ai's powerful research capabilities for current information and practical implementation guidance.

topic.description: The research topic or problem you want to investigate. Be as detailed as possible about what you want to learn, any specific aspects to focus on, timeframes, geographical scope, or particular angles of interest.

tools.name: deepResearch
tools.description: Conduct comprehensive, in-depth research using Exa.ai's exhaustive analysis capabilities for critical decision-making and complex architectural planning.

topic.description: The research topic or problem you want to investigate comprehensively. Be as detailed as possible about what you want to learn, including technical requirements, architectural considerations, performance needs, security concerns, or strategic implications you want analyzed in depth.
